Ten-patient wearable demo

A simple visual view of the 10 simulated patient streams. Choose a scenario and vital sign to see the last reading and its 120-second trend. CSV downloads are available for each patient or for all 10 together.

Research demo only. These are synthetic simulator outputs, not real-time patient readings, medical advice, or a clinically validated dataset. Starting values are provisional demo values. Temperature is simulated.
Download ready-made 10-patient CSV

Observed CSVs contain sensor observations only. “Simulation truth CSV” is a separate synthetic reference stream and is not observed sensor data. Blank chart gaps mean missing measurements; readings are never replaced with zero.
